requirement.evidence: The rents for any housing space shall not be increased more than the percentages stated below in any consecutive 12-month period, irrespective of the number of different tenants occupying the housing space during the 12-month period, any change of ownership of the Landlord or vacancy of the housing space.
requirement.note: Also supported by the 4% cap and the substantial compliance/registration condition in 19:2-3.1 text.

key_value.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
key_value.note: The 12-month period language appears in the preceding paragraph.

status.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%. The allowable annual increase will not be permitted, if the dwelling is not in substantial compliance and/or if the landlord has not met the registration requirements
status.note: The page presents the rule as current law. The moratorium was rescinded 2023-09-18, so it does not block the rule as of 2026-10-01.

citation.evidence: Pursuant to 19:2-3. Rent Increases. 19:2-3.1. Determination of Rents. In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%. The allowable annual increase will not be permitted, if the dwelling is not in substantial compliance and/or if the landlord has not met the registration requirements as specified in this subsection 19:2-9.8. (Ord. 6 PSF-A(S), 9-5-17)
